title: The elder at the Vale of Ash, who gave me the crown and set up the whole 'return the king's crown' resolution, has no reaction dialogue at all when I return to her after resting the Hollow King — contrasted with the reeve and priest, who both have specific new lines acknowledging the outcome.
where: Elder's House, Vale of Ash, after settling the Hollow King
